record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, shorten causal readout pooling from four states to two, retaining the 0.8 current-state/0.2 pooled-state blend and normalization over nonpadding positions. This may preserve immediate intent better given the regression with eight-state pooling. Apply the identical causal readout during training and inference; retain final-real-position selection, maxlen, positional representation, features, embeddings, backbone, scoring, loss and optimizer. Update readout metadata and predictor-writer validation.

category_rationales.rationale: Shorten uniform causal pooling from four observed states to two across all four category models to emphasize immediate intent. Preserve the 0.8 current-state/0.2 pooled-state blend, nonpadding normalization, final-real-position readout, and all other model and training settings. Training and inference share the modified encoder; update checkpoint metadata and predictor validation consistently.
